mentions.name: xiio
mentions.description: A minimal async runtime for Python that is mostly feature complete while using a fraction of the code of asyncio or trio. Built as a hands-on way to explore low-level details and deepen understanding of async programming.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on https://github.com/xi/xiio, a minimal async runtime for python. It is mostly feature complete with a fraction of the code of asyncio or trio.
